description: This file contains the implementation of a Promise class following the Promises/A+ specification, used for asynchronous programming. It defines methods for promise resolution, rejection, chaining, cancellation, and waiting, and manages internal state and handlers.

classes.name: Promise
classes.description: A class implementing Promises/A+ for handling asynchronous operations, supporting chaining, resolution, rejection, cancellation, and state management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Promise with optional wait and cancel functions.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers to the promise, returning a new chained promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches a rejection handler to the promise.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is resolved or rejected, optionally unwrapping the result.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('PENDING', 'FULFILLED', 'REJECTED').

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise if it is pending, invoking the cancel function if provided.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Fulfills the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Internal method to set the promise's state and handle resolution or rejection logic.

methods.name: callHandler
methods.description: Static method to execute a handler callback with proper error handling and resolve/reject logic.

methods.name: waitIfPending
methods.description: Ensures the promise is resolved or rejected, invoking wait functions or wait list as needed.

methods.name: invokeWaitFn
methods.description: Calls the wait function to resolve the promise.

methods.name: invokeWaitList
methods.description: Invokes wait on all promises in the wait list.
